product_contract: Version-2 Answers pane stores exact chosen session/graph/member/annotation/text-hash targets only; R0 SaveSession acknowledgement persists the view, with no durable corpus or answer-store copy.

Research owner is derived from validated current session. All valid attached capture versions are published through one coordinated publisher per owner/opening; every ask validates a nonempty exact subset. Any unavailable chosen source fails the whole ask.
Existing trail actor is the only Fjall owner; exact reads use R2 NoFetcher plus R0 integrity validation, with live facet, session/store and generation checks.
Visited-only X, legacy PageText, orphan inventory, unchosen A2 and foreign-session sources never substitute for chosen evidence. Equal text under distinct provenance remains separately selectable.
Citation activation checks run namespace, supplied passage identity, exact requested scope, full canonical hash, nonempty Unicode scalar range and excerpt before queueing the R2 saved-source reader.
Source choice changes preserve past asks/citations while those versions remain admitted. Durable answer/prompt evidence stays in the existing resident.
Complete encoded corpus including JSON escaping must fit the existing 128 KiB ceiling; excess visibly refuses before generation, without truncation or blocking local reading.
Legacy version-1 pane payloads receive explicit admission help; PageText data, namespaces, history and strict resolver are preserved without implicit capture conversion or a UI migration claim.
integration_repairs: Worker completion queues a generation-fenced semantic citation intent and wakes the host independently of viewport rendering; repeat activation re-resolves.
Citation destination sets graph focus and transfers maximization when needed.
Malformed Unicode manifest labels use character-safe display shortening and remain unavailable without poisoning the bridge.

Saved reader body and quote use display paragraphs bounded to 4096 UTF-8 bytes to avoid the observed Harfrust u16 glyph-counter overflow; full canonical bytes, hash and global selectors remain unchanged.
Current supplier raster source errors remain attributable capture refusals; native translation errors propagate to presentation/capture failure and legacy inner scenes show explicit diagnostics.

qualification_limits: 11 ignored and 89 shared-place/Sky tests are not counted as bounded passes. The opt-in wrong-owner probe is reported separately as actually executed; three capture-library controls also run separately.
The native model earns an exact-quotation citation. Three earlier marker prompts produced uncited answers; no headed model-marker reliability or broad answer-quality claim.
Two fresh Turnstone OS processes and reopened resident composition/journal in the same resident host process. No installed resident lifecycle or resident OS-process restart qualification.
App-native controls and real presentation/readback on macOS only; no Windows/Linux, OS assistive activation or human AT qualification.
R0 acknowledged writes and tested process reopen are preserved. No new power-loss guarantee or atomic transaction across graph, facets, frame and resident journal.
Ordinary saved HTML canonical text only; hosted page replay, PDFs/screenshots, authored Knot notes, deliberate sharing and the separate R4 complete research task remain outside this slice.
